**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **Direction check:** The only MFN language in the agreement is at § 6 (p0047) and benefits us — TrueLink warrants that Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," together with a one-year price freeze.
- **No Customer-side burden:** § 5 (Compensation) sets only ordinary fee/invoicing terms, and § 8 (Client covenants and warranties) covers compliance, access limits, credit-data licence and content reps — none require us to extend TrueLink our best third-party terms or to match competing offers.
- **Result:** Meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) while preserving a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour, which per the rule we keep intact.
